brand.official: settlecore.org is the official website of DR.LIFE+. This site does not process sign-in or payment and will never ask for passwords or bank-card details.

home.title: Infinite possibilities for life
home.subtitle: INFINITE POSSIBILITIES
home.intro: DR.LIFE+ is Cambodia’s next-generation integrated commerce platform. Starting with home and building materials, it connects supply, local fulfilment and online commerce.
stats: Phnom Penh local warehouse · reservations open
home.visionTitle: Starting with homes and building materials, becoming Cambodia’s commerce infrastructure
home.visionIntro: We go deep in one industry first, then extend our supply, fulfilment and commerce capabilities to more categories and everyday moments.
stages: Starting with tiles, flooring, bathrooms, doors, paint and furniture.
More categories will reuse the same service capability.
Financial services are offered only with licensed institutions and are not yet available.
home.ecoTitle: One platform, connecting the commercial chain
home.ecoIntro: Commerce brings customers, fulfilment builds trust, and services create efficiency.
home.chainTitle: From Chinese factory to Phnom Penh customer
home.chainNote: Confirmed item by item for each product and order; the quotation prevails.
partners: 0% sales commission and storage from US$15/m³/month, with warehousing and fulfilment charges visible on one bill.
No need to build an overseas warehouse: Guangzhou consolidation, cross-border transport, Phnom Penh inbound warehousing and online sales in one flow.
Logistics, payment, financial institutions and investment partners are building Cambodia’s commercial infrastructure together.

merchant.title: Open an online building-materials shop in Phnom Penh, with no commission
merchant.intro: For local merchants and Chinese brands or manufacturers entering Cambodia.
steps: Open the merchant Bot in Telegram, choose a language and accept the merchant agreement.
Submit business and contact information for verification only.
The result is sent by Bot; missing items are explained.
Complete specifications and prices using the category template.
Book inbound delivery; available quantities follow warehouse inventory.
merchant.feesIntro: All fees follow the formal quotation and published fee notice.
fees: Volume-based, accrued daily and billed monthly.
Confirmed item by item for each product and order; the quotation prevails.

legal.privacyIntro: This policy applies to DR.LIFE+ related services. Operator: [company name, to be filled in].
legal.termsIntro: This agreement is a draft; bracketed items require company and legal confirmation.
privacySections: This policy applies to the buyer, merchant and driver Mini Apps and related services. Operator: [company name, to be filled in]; contact: /contact.
This includes Telegram user ID, information you provide, order and funds records, usage information, uploaded photos and proofs, and a driver’s location while performing tasks.
To provide and improve services, process orders, delivery, settlement and reconciliation, send notices, and conduct risk control and compliance audit.
Profiles contain tags and pseudonymous IDs only, not raw chat text. Personal information is removed before an external AI call.
We share only necessary information with necessary partners to provide the service; except where required by law, we do not sell personal information.
Data is stored in [server location, to be filled in]; content with personal information removed may be processed abroad.
Accounting and audit records are retained as required by law; after the period or a deletion request, data is deleted or anonymised.
You may view, correct and delete personal information, withdraw consent, request export or account deletion.
Encryption in transit, encrypted storage for sensitive information, permission-based back-office access and audit logs.
Users under [age, to be confirmed by a lawyer] need guardian consent.
Service notices are sent by Telegram Bot; marketing notices are off by default.
A new version requires users to read and accept it again.
termsSections: DR.LIFE+ provides product display, merchant warehousing and delivery, and order and funds records through Telegram Mini Apps.
Each person has one account per role; keep it secure and do not transfer it.
Goods are paid for outside the Platform; the Platform records payment proof only. The Platform does not lend or guarantee.
Sales commission is 0% and the settlement service fee is 0. Fee changes are announced in advance.
Funds are held in a dedicated partner-bank account and are not used by the Platform.
Receipt requires proof; after-sales help may be requested if there is a problem.
Prohibited or illegal goods must not be listed and product information must be true.
AI answers are for reference only and are not financial or legal advice.
Advertising is labelled and does not affect organic ranking.
To the extent allowed by law, the Platform is not liable for events beyond its control or third-party actions.
An account may be suspended or disabled for a breach or risk, with a reason given.
A new version requires users to read and accept it again.
Cambodian law applies. Disputes are negotiated first, then submitted to [a competent court, to be confirmed by a lawyer].

deleteAccount.title: Account and data deletion
deleteAccount.intro: Submit a deletion request in the Mini App’s Me page. Data required by law will be anonymised only.
steps: Open Me and select account and data deletion.
